wiring: sequential, one pass, no retry loop
why_not_one_prompt: A prompt asked to write 12% will write 12%. Splitting a messy draft is a language job; deciding whether a rate is on the list is a lookup, so it stays in code the model can't override.

agents.name: Extractor
agents.goal: Split the draft into one line per rate or term, numbers unchanged
agents.uses: LLM if a key is set (OpenAI gpt-4o-mini or Gemini 2.0 Flash), else line-by-line split
agents.guard: Any model line containing a number not in the draft is discarded

agents.name: Citation checker
agents.goal: For each line, find the price-list line for that item; pass only if every ₹, GST %, HSN and other number is on it

agents.name: Pack writer
agents.goal: Lay out the quote with each line next to its list line, and list what was removed

agents.name: Critic
agents.goal: Hold Send while any line is off the list. Never fill in a replacement rate
agents.uses: src/Product.tsx (no model); human removes or fixes
agents.pattern: Reflection against an external signal, human in the loop
